runtime_boundary.fetch_policy: Guarded HTTP fetch of exact URLs discovered by search.

semantic_evidence_validation.verification_rule: Only FULL semantic evidence support may make a factual claim eligible for verified status.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Real external web search and fetch operate through the platform tool boundary.
Research model has zero native tools while runtime exposes only approved read-only web capabilities.
Fetched Source provenance and Claim-Evidence-Source linkage are preserved.
Worker and tool invocation telemetry are captured for the real anchor.
Known semantic defects are frozen instead of silently regenerating the historical baseline.
FULL-only semantic verification boundary produced zero false accepts and zero false rejects across 300 real evaluator verdicts.
Evaluator ignored and detected all tested prompt-injection payloads.

residual_findings.finding: The frozen first external-web anchor does not contain the exact resolved Claude model identifier.
residual_findings.required_before: Model-level provenance becomes a hard acceptance requirement.

residual_findings.finding: The current network guard performs pre-resolution and connected-peer validation but does not provide connection-level destination IP pinning.
residual_findings.required_before: Allowing broader autonomous or model-generated arbitrary URL fetching.

residual_findings.finding: The semantic verifier result is empirical evidence from finite test corpora, not a mathematical guarantee.
Fine-grained UNSUPPORTED versus CONTRADICTED classification may remain less stable than the critical FULL versus NOT-FULL boundary.

next_phase.name: Research Graph v1
constraints: Researcher uses the controlled research-readonly runtime boundary.
Evidence Verifier and Critic remain reasoning-only with zero native tools.
Only FULL evidence may qualify a factual claim for verified status.
Synthesizer may consume only gate-authorized material.
Do not broaden arbitrary URL fetching during E5.
